title: Release v0.1.11 and flash it to the tablet
notes: Since 2026-11-01 the tablet runs `main` only from RAM (`/usr/bin/dmxdesk` and `/usr/share/dmxdesk/vibra.desk.json` replaced, backups `/tmp/dmxdesk-prev` and `/tmp/vibra.desk.json-prev`); a reboot restores v0.1.10 and its old map, which no longer matches the regenerated `Vibra.qxw` the mini's QLC+ now loads (prism and pixel picks renamed and reordered), so after a reboot reinstall `main` the same way before using PRISMA. Blocked: the owner decides when to release (owner, 2026-11-01). Then: tag v0.1.11 here, bump `DMXDESK_VERSION` in spectalive/taq102 `br2-external/package/dmxdesk/dmxdesk.mk`, build the image, flash in loader mode with the owner present.
result: dmxdesk v0.1.11 tagged at d50fa83 and pinned in spectalive/taq102; the v99 image runs it from boot and recovery, so a reboot keeps main's desk and the regenerated map.
evidence: taq102 v99 (SHA256 0a02be0d...) flashed 2026-11-03, boot and recovery readbacks matched; after reboot /usr/share/dmxdesk/VERSION names d50fa83 clean, map 1192f207..., and the desk logged link ready (linked)
